scope: All 206 actual Intel HVF guest controls pass, including cold MP firmware discovery for 1/2/4 CPUs, guest-derived count/APIC identities, AP startup and two acknowledged IPIs per AP. The previous 203 controls replay in the same signed consumer.

assumption_register.assumption: The archived consumer is the one executed for these observations.
assumption_register.basis: Build and execution prepared records and executable SHA256 match; strict codesign verification exits0 before guest execution.
assumption_register.stress_test: Both complete artifact ZIP API digests, every member byte hash, and build/execution record equality.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: Executable or prepared metadata mismatch, failed signature verification, or any source hash mismatch.

assumption_register.assumption: The runner executes a native Intel process with an available HVF VM.
assumption_register.basis: GenuineIntel CPUID, translated=0, native_intel_process=true, successful VM creation plus actual guest controls.
assumption_register.stress_test: The availability-only probe is insufficient; require 206 strict ordered Boolean passes and actual guest command exit code 0.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: Translation, failed VM creation, missing guest observations, non-Boolean passes or failed guest command.
assumption_register.status: confirmed within runner domain; hypervisor_guest=1 is retained

bounded_scope.item: The tested signed consumer is pinned to firmware commit 3d500416f. Later A32 changes and remaining MMIO/private-state/IRQ/debug/replay profiles need their own evidence.
The host reports hypervisor_guest=1. This qualifies the recorded native Intel HVF runner, not a bare-metal host or every Intel model.
